title: spec(types,plugin-dashboard,app-shell,plugin-designer): widgets[] entries read by the slot's element type, a typeless widget draws as `metric` and an unknown type the placeholder, the object-chart producers name ObjectChartSchema (objectui#11514)
body:
Fixes #11514

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

objectui#11514 is rescoped by the seat's answers (comment 5964120765) to three things, all in this PR: objectui#11483's closure (`DashboardWidgetSchema['type']` drops the component type, and every reader of a `widgets[]` entry reads it by the slot's element type), both `object-chart` producers named `ObjectChartSchema` with no cast, and Q2 A (what a widget with no `type`, or with a `type` that names nothing, draws). The `object-metric` producer moved to objectui#11525 and is untouched here. The class-a finding this PR's first report raised (a rule-list `filter` with a structured `groupBy` draws an error) is filed as objectui#11526.

## What changed — before and after

| | before (`fc7db059f`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `DashboardWidgetSchema['type']` (TS face) | `DashboardWidgetTypeName \| DashboardComponentWidgetType` | `DashboardWidgetTypeName`, the zod twin's set |
| `{ type: 'metric-card', title }` directly in `widgets[]` | compiles (the MEASURED LIMIT pin); both zod faces refuse | `tsc` refuses it too; zod faces unchanged |
| read type of a `widgets[]` entry in `DashboardRenderer`, `DashboardGridLayout`, `DashboardWithConfig`, `isLegacyRetiredWidget` and the designer's `DashboardEditor` | `DashboardWidgetSchema` | `DashboardComponentSchema['widgets'][number]` |
| `DashboardRendererProps['onWidgetsReorder']` parameter, and app-shell `DashboardPreview`'s handler | `DashboardWidgetSchema[]` | `DashboardComponentSchema['widgets']` |
| `WidgetDispatch['chartType']` | `string` | `SeriesChartFamily`: the 12 series families, each a member of `ObjectChartSchema['chartType']` |
| both `object-chart` producers | untyped literal, `chartType` typed `string` | `satisfies ObjectChartSchema`, no cast |
| a widget with no `type`, both surfaces | the slot-component passthrough: the red "Unknown component type" (OBJUI-001) panel; dataset-bound with a dimension: a bar chart | draws exactly what the same widget with `type: 'metric'` draws: inline, dataset-bound, and in `DashboardRenderer`'s mobile metric row |
| a `type` that names no family and no component type, both surfaces | the passthrough: the OBJUI-001 panel | the labelled placeholder "「type」chart type is not supported yet", as `heatmap` draws |
| the slot-component passthrough | every entry no family matched | the component arm (`metric-card`) alone, drawn as before |
| the legacy `component` envelope | its node, handed to `SchemaRenderer` bare | the same node; a typeless envelope keeps its card heading (the spec default is not applied to it); a number or `true` in it goes through `toRenderableSchema`, which draws the same text |

What renders differently is exactly the two cases Q2 A lifts: a typeless widget and an unknown-type widget. Every widget that names a known family draws as before, and so does every legacy envelope (control below).

## Q2 A: the ruling and how it lands

「协议为基准」: `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0's `DashboardWidgetSchema.type` defaults to `metric`. objectui's validator accepts a typeless widget and does not write the default in, so the surfaces are where it resolves.

- `specDefaultWidgetType()` reads the default from the spec (`DashboardWidgetSchema.shape.type.parse(undefined)`), not a literal; a row pins it to `metric` at the installed spec.
- `resolveWidgetType(entry)` is the authored `type`, or that default when the entry names none. Every read of an entry's `type` on both surfaces goes through it: the dispatch, the metric span and self-contained chrome, the mobile metric row. `DatasetWidget` takes the same default.
- The legacy `component` envelope (`{ id, component, layout }`, objectui's own format, no member on the spec's widget) is not given the default: `resolveWidgetType` keeps `undefined` for an entry whose `component` is truthy, the same test both surfaces use to take the envelope branch.
- `isSlotComponentEntry(entry)` gates the passthrough to the component arm; anything else that reaches it draws `unsupportedWidgetSchema`, the placeholder an unsupported family already drew, now declared once for both surfaces.
- `entryComponent(entry)` reads the envelope's `component` typed as the widget arm declares it. A bare `entry.component` read through `BaseSchema`'s index signature and made both `getComponentSchema`s return `any`, which is what had let an earlier cast removal look clean.

## The `object-metric` producer

Not touched, and no type added for it: it moved to objectui#11525. The premise measurement (branch B: the broadcast's `$and` carries the widget's MongoDB-style `filter`, and the bar's rule list makes the spec-shape aggregate branch draw an error) is in this card's first `os-dev-report` (comment 5964044891). It stays red under V1, as expected.

## V1 census

Probe: PR #11512's branch (`ff7f748e`) merged with this branch at `2fb1b92b` through `git merge-tree` in a throwaway worktree (the one known conflict, `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`'s comment opener, restored by hand). Nothing was committed or pushed from it; the worktree and its ref are removed.

- **Cast sites:** 8 lines, the card's 4 sites in plugin-dashboard's src and test programs: `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` 648 and 701, `DashboardRenderer.tsx` 1077 and 1118, each in both programs. 0 new lines. The types test program: 1 line, `node-recursion-point-8344`'s drift ratchet, objectui#11515's (unchanged from the first report).
- **What holds them, per branch** (a probe-only annotation typing both `getComponentSchema`s as the renderer's prop, `DeclaredNode | string | null | undefined`): the `object-metric` branch (`DashboardGridLayout` 381, 383; `DashboardRenderer` 876, 878, 879), objectui#11525; `plugin-dashboard:metric` (`DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES.metric` typed `string`; 396 and 894), objectui#11466's registry entry; `DashboardGridLayout`'s static `pivot` (472), objectui#11466. The passthrough and the unknown-type branch: 0. The envelope branch: 0. Before the `toRenderableSchema` bridge it was 2 (`string | number | true | DeclaredNode`).
- The two `SchemaRenderer` casts stay: the branches they cover are objectui#11525's and objectui#11466's.
- **Not re-probed:** the merge of `main` `9ed8d0f1` (objectui#11517) that followed. NOT MEASURED, because rebuilding the probe means a fresh install and closure build on a shared box. What was checked instead: none of objectui#11517's 15 files is among V1's own 74 changed files; `git merge-tree` of the new head with `ff7f748e` shows only the same one conflict; and `main`'s type-check at the new head is green.

## Pins, controls, reverse verification, ablation

- `widget-type-default-and-unknown-11514.test.tsx` (12 tests). On both surfaces: a typeless widget draws byte-for-byte what `type: 'metric'` draws, inline and dataset-bound (the control is the explicit `metric`), and in the mobile layout (non-vacuity: its 2-column metric row is drawn). An unknown `type` (`gauge2`) draws the placeholder and no OBJUI-001 panel. Controls: `heatmap` draws the same placeholder; a `metric-card` still draws through the component arm. Plus one row: the spec default is `metric`.
- **Reverse verification:** the three surface files at `b92e80dc` (before Q2 A): 7 failed, 5 passed (the 5 are the controls and the spec-default row). Restored from `HEAD`, blob-matched.
- `dashboard-producer-node-types-11514.test.tsx` (32 tests): round one's 28, plus a number and `true` in a legacy `component` envelope, on both surfaces, drawn under the widget's heading.
- **Envelope control:** those 4 rows against the surfaces at `b92e80dc` pass (4 passed, 28 skipped), so the envelope draws as it did. **Ablation:** the envelope exemption removed from `resolveWidgetType` (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `7f60e1c6` to `da48a7f9`): all 4 rows fail. Restored: blob equal to `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Round one's: the `SERIES_CHART_FAMILIES` ablation (`'gauge'` planted: 2 `tsc` errors at both `satisfies ObjectChartSchema` sites, 2 vitest rows red), the `DashboardPreview` reverse verification (TS2322 at its `onWidgetsReorder` prop), and the objectui#11483 `@ts-expect-error` row.

## Readers of the narrowed type

Needed an edit: plugin-dashboard's `DashboardRenderer`, `DashboardGridLayout`, `DashboardWithConfig`, `isLegacyRetiredWidget`, `DatasetWidget` (the default `type`), and two test readers; app-shell's `DashboardPreview` (type-only); plugin-designer's `DashboardEditor` and three test readers (its build went red on 3 lines once the component type left the widget arm); the types pins for objectui#11483 and objectui#7952 and `zod-mirror-parity`'s `KnownDrift` row; the plugin page and the plugin-dashboard README, which taught `const widgets: DashboardWidgetSchema[] = dashboard.widgets` and now narrow on `type` and say what a typeless or unknown-type widget draws.

Needed nothing: core's `buildWidgetScopedFilter`, `useWidgetSubCaption`, app-shell's `DashboardWidgetInspector`, and `apps/*`. Render suites outside the package that mount a dashboard (app-shell's `DashboardView` and previews, `StudioDesignSurface`, the widget DOM-leak sweep, the schema-catalog galleries, the console's drill-down and chart-stub suites) pass unchanged.

## Changeset sweep

- **This PR's entries:** `11514-types-widget-arm-type` (`@object-ui/types` minor), `11514-dashboard-slot-entry-types` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` minor; now also states the typeless and unknown-type renders, the passthrough serving the component arm, and the envelope exemption), `11514-designer-dashboard-entry-type` and `11514-app-shell-dashboard-preview-reorder` (patch, type-only).
- **Dated notes (2026-10-03), from round one:** `11483-metric-card-needs-value`, `7952-dashboard-widgets-component-arm`, `11348-dashboard-widget-reads`, `dashboard-widget-type-closed-enum`.
- **Swept again for Q2 A, no new note needed:** `dashboard-widget-type-closed-enum` (its OBJUI-001 sentence describes the hatch before that change, still true of it), `8760-unfulfilled-chart-stubs` (its OBJUI-001 sentence is about a document node, not a `widgets[]` entry), `7952-dashboard-widgets-component-arm` ("What still refuses" is about validation), `10859-dashboard-node-keys` and `11483-metric-card-needs-value` (unchanged), and objectui#11517's three entries (drill-down only).

## Acceptance notes

- **Filed by the seat:** the class-a finding (an authored `object-metric` with a rule-list `properties.filter` and a structured `aggregate.groupBy` draws `UnloweredAggregateWhereError` instead of its number), as objectui#11526.
- **File surface beyond the claim's list:** plugin-designer's `DashboardEditor` and its three tests, `DatasetWidget`, the two docs pages, the objectui#7952 pin, the two plugin-dashboard test readers, `isLegacyRetiredWidget`, and the static `chart` producer's `chartType`. Each is the same retype or the Q2 A ruling, and is named above.
- **Merges of `main`:** `b92e80dc` (`8366accd1`), `9b0ec494` (`6903eafbc`, objectui#11484's docs) and `7939c9a0` (`9ed8d0f1`, objectui#11517). All three merged cleanly.
- The title drops "part 1": the card is rescoped to what this PR holds.

Governed-surface guard over the 29 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

The one new runtime import, `@objectstack/spec/ui` in `widgetDispatch.ts`, is a module app-shell already imports eagerly (`UnifiedSidebar`, `MetadataProvider`), and no registration input moved.
